title: 账单争议与服务恢复
purpose: 展示客服先承接账单争议，再在问题解决后判断是否有合适的后续方案。

steps.label: 接入账单来电
steps.description: 把客户、通话和客服身份绑定到当前会话。

steps.label: 客户说明账单问题
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Hello, I’m calling about an unexpected monthly charge on my latest statement.
steps.description: 客户先说明账单问题，平台开始从 transcript 识别费用主题。

steps.label: 客服确认并开始核查
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I can review the statement with you. I’ll check the charge details first and make sure we address your question before anything else.
steps.description: 客服确认处理顺序，先核查账单而不是直接推荐。

steps.label: 客户补充金额和时间
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: The statement shows a charge from this month, but I don’t remember approving it or seeing it explained.
steps.description: 客户补充账单细节，费用主题持续。

steps.label: 客服复述账单诉求
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: You’re asking us to identify the charge, explain why it appeared, and correct it if it was not expected. I’ll do that now.
steps.description: 客服复述客户诉求，把核查、解释和纠正作为服务目标。

steps.label: 客户表达费用不满
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: This feels unfair and expensive, and I need someone to resolve it rather than send me another offer.
steps.description: 客户明确表达不满；费用情绪变为负面，投诉信号 active。

steps.label: 客服承诺先处理账单
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I understand. I’ll keep this call focused on the billing issue and explain the result clearly before we consider anything else.
steps.description: 客服承接客户情绪并锁定当前服务范围。

steps.label: 客户要求先完成核查
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: That’s what I need. Please tell me what caused the charge and whether it can be credited back.
steps.description: 客户明确当前优先级，为后续商业抑制提供对话依据。

steps.label: 暂不展示商业建议
steps.description: 即使模型认为客户可能相关，未解决的账单问题仍然阻断额外商业推荐。

steps.label: 客服确认不会打扰式推荐
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: Understood. I’ll resolve the charge first, and I won’t add a new product conversation while the billing issue is open.
steps.description: 客服根据实时辅助确认处理顺序，避免在投诉未解决时给出商业打扰。

steps.label: 客户接受处理方案
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: If you can credit the charge and explain the account clearly, that will solve it for me.
steps.description: 客户确认可接受的解决条件。

steps.label: 客服提出账单修正
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I found the charge and can issue the credit today. I’ll also leave a clear note explaining what happened.
steps.description: 客服给出具体修正动作，等待客户确认后正式改变投诉权威。

steps.label: 客户确认账单已解决
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Thank you. That answers my question, and I’m comfortable with the credit and explanation.
steps.description: 客户确认服务结果，下一步可以由业务流程正式记录解决。

steps.label: 客服完成问题处理
steps.description: 授权业务事件确认账单问题已经处理完成。

steps.label: 客服确认账单状态
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: The billing issue is now resolved. If you have another question about saving regularly, I can explain the available options.
steps.description: 权威状态解决后，客服自然地打开后续问题空间。

steps.label: 客户提出储蓄问题
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Now that this is sorted out, could you show me an easier way to save a small amount each month?
steps.description: 客户在账单问题解决后主动提出后续需求，平台可以重新评估商业辅助。

steps.label: 生成后续辅助建议
steps.description: 当前问题解决后，资格、产品事实、指导和解释校验通过，建议才可出现。

steps.label: 建议送达客服桌面
steps.description: 记录服务端完成发布。

steps.label: 客服桌面确认显示
steps.description: 记录浏览器已经应用当前完整辅助快照。

steps.label: 结束通话
steps.description: 结束实时会话并撤回仍然活跃的辅助建议。

steps.label: 生成服务总结
steps.description: 把最终 transcript snapshot 写入 post-call interaction record。

steps.label: 确认重复执行安全
steps.description: 再次执行同一 post-call job，不产生重复记录。
